tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 65.7% on Terminal Bench 4.0, closing in on Claude Opus 5.5 in coding performance. Confirmed by Crypto Briefing.
OpenAI has set a target valuation of 1.25 trillion dollars. Reported by Bloomberg.
Cybersecurity experts are sounding the alarm over a new era of hacking enabled by machine learning. A critical PHP flaw discovered by artificial intelligence is exposing 70% of sites. Confirmed by The Guardian.
OpenAI faces a deceptive claims and child user safety lawsuit in Texas. Reported by Bloomberg Law News.
OpenAI is rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users. Reported by OpenAI.
Free every hour.
